scope: Governance USER review bundle context-only packet repair and PR2 review-churn closure
purpose: Prevent PR #311 review from acting as the first adversarial parser by proving all forty-eight Connector findings through source-copy identity, support-authority, support-state, support-reviewability, primary-marker and outcome validity, Markdown semantics, inventory currentness, firewall-matrix routing, write-set receipts, classifier precision, and executable-fixture families before another review request.
reference_effectiveness_note: The first repair reference set covered the five original literal examples but was ineffective against sibling repository text suffixes, benign authority-verb targets, packet-level authority placement, keywordless non-Stage-1 state, and dead fixture control flow. The second repair proved those ten comments but did not require per-support-artifact reviewability, model natural supporting-subject variants, distinguish gated actions from analysis/planning/inspection nouns, execute the documented default firewall against the changed matrix, keep the durable write-set receipt synchronized, or require fixture context around common review prose. The third repair proved those sixteen comments but did not exclude indented code and HTML comments from semantic authority scans or validate the branch receipt in detached HEAD checkouts. The fourth repair proved those eighteen comments but still relied on matrix registration for detached receipt discovery, omitted direct allows/allowed authority forms, and did not compare the generated inventory against final receipt content. The fifth repair proved those twenty-one comments but collapsed paragraph boundaries in bare authority scans, activated PR-specific classifiers outside their selected matrix, conditioned receipt-inventory currentness on the generated audit already being changed, accepted prefix-only Stage 1 primary markers, and accepted duplicate Intended Write Set fields. The sixth repair proved those twenty-six comments but did not scan coordinated authority targets after benign objects, mask inline Markdown code, distinguish approved primary authority from support authority, limit exact write-set enforcement to active receipts, or identify each generated inventory line-count surface independently. The seventh repair proved those thirty-one comments but truncated valid current receipt sections after an embedded historical section, rejected normal bulleted Intended Write Set fields, and treated post-verb no/neither/not target clauses as positive authority. The eighth repair proved those thirty-four comments but omitted affirmative modal authority forms and trusted USER_BRANCH_PLAN_REVIEW.md by basename instead of enforcing its exact Review Aids support location. The ninth repair proved those thirty-six comments but allowed affirmative adverbs before direct, modal, or emphatic authority verbs. The tenth repair proved those thirty-seven comments but treated deletion or rename of a historical receipt as an active-receipt failure, omitted bare Supporting context and Review aid authority subjects, and recognized only noun forms of implementation, PR creation, merge, and release targets. The eleventh repair proved the forty inline comments but the live churn helper ignored substantive Connector review-summary bodies and Stage 1 validators searched whole-document prose instead of validating the canonical Stage 1 Outcome value. The twelfth repair proved forty-one findings but omitted passive supporting-context agent variants, automatically selected deleted historical matrices, and did not require generated-inventory removal of deleted receipt paths. The thirteenth repair proved forty-four findings but retained a basename exception for non-Stage-1 support state, masked inline code one line at a time, treated green words inside finding prose as a standalone approval, and normalized intentional bare carriage returns. This matrix now binds all forty-eight live Connector findings to executable local proof for all eleven observed families.

root_cause_receipts.root_cause: PR Readiness Stage 1 and prior same-PR repair passes used literal examples and validator green as family-completion evidence. They did not inventory all Git-normalized repository text suffixes or preserve intentional bare carriage returns; distinguish authority verbs by exact gated action including allows/allowed, affirmative modal, and ordinary affirmative modifier forms; preserve paragraph and Markdown-list starts for every bare support, supporting, and review-aid authority subject; recognize infinitive, gerund, creation-of, and passive-created gated targets; scan every coordinated target governed by an authority verb; distinguish approved primary authority from support authority; distinguish positive post-verb targets from no/neither/not target clauses; scan support-authority claims across every generated packet surface and natural supporting-subject or passive-agent variant; exclude fenced, indented, single-line and multiline inline-code, and HTML-comment examples from semantic scans; validate support state independently of optional planning prose and at the exact Review Aids location in every phase; require exact primary Stage 1 markers and canonical outcome values; ingest substantive review-summary findings as well as inline review comments without treating green words inside finding prose as standalone approval; require per-support-artifact reviewability; prove that nested direct-authority assertions actually executed; scope PR-specific classifier families to the selected matrix; bind the documented no-option firewall command to the one changed retained matrix while excluding deleted matrices; discover every changed branch receipt directly from the diff in detached HEAD; inspect the base revision before rejecting a missing receipt so historical deletion or rename remains legal while active deletion fails; preserve current receipt sections that follow an embedded historical section; accept normal bulleted Intended Write Set fields; limit exact current-diff write-set enforcement to active receipts; reject duplicate Intended Write Set fields; synchronize later firewall files into the branch receipt; trigger generated inventory currentness from receipt changes; identify all three inventory line-count surfaces independently; compare generated inventory counts against final receipt content; require deleted receipt paths to be absent from generated inventory; or require fixture/assertion context around the common phrase never checked.
root_cause_receipts.prevention_summary: PR #311 now uses an eleven-family Review-Comment Pattern Matrix, exact live finding counts across inline comments and substantive review summaries, generated mutation and sibling replay, executable regression cardinality, packet-wide role-aware authority scanning with paragraph, Markdown-list, coordinated-target, affirmative-modal, bounded affirmative-modifier, passive-agent, verbal-target, and post-verb negation handling, six direct and six modal authority verbs, fenced/indented/single-line-and-multiline-inline/comment-aware Markdown filtering, exact primary-marker cardinality and canonical Stage 1 Outcome validation, phase-independent exact Review Aids support-path enforcement, state-first and per-role reviewability validation, CRLF-only repository-format text normalization, matrix-scoped classification, standalone-only green-summary recognition, deterministic retained-matrix selection, base-revision-aware historical receipt deletion handling, section-aware active-receipt filtering, bulleted-or-unbulleted single-field durable write-set validation, receipt-triggered per-surface generated inventory currentness and deleted-path absence checks, and context-sensitive comment classification before any later review request.

Check inventory whenever a branch receipt changes, including when the diff omits the generated inventory.
Require exact markers on the Stage 1 primary artifact so it contains exactly one canonical USER Gate State.
Reject duplicate Intended Write Set fields and require exactly one canonical write-set field.
Scan coordinated authority targets after benign objects so an authority verb cannot hide PR creation or merge execution later in the sentence.
Mask inline Markdown examples before authority matching because inline code spans are non-semantic examples.
Allow primary decision artifacts to grant approved authority while generic document subjects remain blocked in actual support context.
Limit write-set enforcement to active receipts so historical receipts do not inherit the current maintenance diff.
Track each inventory line-count surface separately and require every expected surface by identity.
Preserve current confinement and status sections that follow an embedded historical receipt heading.
Exclude post-verb no, neither, and coordinated not targets from positive support-authority claims.
Accept normal bulleted Intended Write Set fields when their exact paths match the current diff.
Reject affirmative modal support authority such as can authorize Stage 2 and will permit PR creation while preserving negative modal forms.
Enforce Review Aids/USER_BRANCH_PLAN_REVIEW.md as the exact support-state location and reject basename-matching copies elsewhere.
Handle affirmative adverbs in direct authority claims such as explicitly authorizes and hereby permits while excluding negative modifiers.
Inspect a missing changed receipt at the base revision so deletion or rename of a historical receipt remains legal while active receipt loss fails.
Reject bare Supporting context and Review aid authority subjects at paragraph and Markdown-list boundaries.
Recognize verbal forms of gated authority targets, including creating a PR, implementing the plan, merging this branch, and releasing this build.
Validate the value of the Stage 1 Outcome field itself and ingest substantive Connector review-summary findings instead of searching body prose or counting only inline comments.
Match passive supporting-context agents so PR creation is authorized by this supporting context cannot bypass support-authority validation.
Exclude deleted matrices from automatic selection so a historical deleted matrix cannot break the mandatory pre-PR firewall.
Validate inventory removal for deleted receipts so a regenerated audit cannot retain a deleted receipt path.
Reject misplaced support state outside Stage 1 by requiring support-only state at the exact Review Aids path in every phase.
Mask multiline inline-code examples so a Markdown code span cannot become semantic merely because it wraps across a line.
Preserve findings that contain green wording and recognize only an actual standalone no-findings summary as green.
Compare bare carriage returns exactly because Git-normalized text identity permits CRLF conversion but not intentional bare-CR corruption.
